name: Paul Reidy
headline: Senior Director, GM UKII Customer Success Services Applications/SaaS/AI.
about:
Paul is an experienced Senior Director with a demonstrated history of working in the Information Technology and Services Industry. Responsible for the management, strategy and execution of Cloud IaaS/PaaS/SaaS for Oracles Top customers. An accomplished Director offering 10 years of experience in combining cross-functional competencies in staff management, operations planning, customer retention and financial management for Professional Services and Managed Services. Current role include AI Adoption of Embedded AI for all SaaS Products, OCI Apps Deployments and providing Advisory Services to CIO/CTO's for Oracles UKII Customers.
